candidate.title: inDrop
candidate.scope: The inDrop row of the supplied Illumina poster schematic, from cell suspension and primer-bearing hydrogel microspheres through cell-droplet assembly, UV primer release, intact-droplet pooling, broad cDNA synthesis/amplification and sequencing. The target is indexing-droplets single-cell RNA sequencing, associated with Klein et al., Cell 2015 (PMID 26000487; DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2015.04.044). The separate cell-droplet and microsphere inputs are retained as drawn schematic interfaces; they do not establish literal staged droplet fusion in the primary implementation. Adjacent DR-Seq, Nuc-Seq and the clipped Hi-SCL row are outside this card's scope, not depicted inDrop alternatives. CEL-Seq is a downstream processing component named by the primary paper, not another target; the collection page's similar-methods list and ESAT application do not expand scope.
